-- Phase 1: spec for stamp. Bodies are stubs until Phase 2.

-- Two-digit, zero-padded decimal for 0..99.
pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0
  pre n <= 99
  post out.char_count() == 2
  ex pad2(0) == "00"
  ex pad2(7) == "07"
  ex pad2(59) == "59"
  if n < 10
    return "0\(n)"
  "\(n)"

-- Unix seconds to "HH:MM:SS" in UTC, 24-hour, zero padded.
-- Floor division and modulo keep negative timestamps on the previous day.
stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(-1) == "23:59:59"
  let secs = ts % 86400
  let h = secs // 3600
  let m = (secs % 3600) // 60
  let s = secs % 60
  "\(pad2(h)):\(pad2(m)):\(pad2(s))"
